methods_quotes.q: Cases were weighted to allow calculation of national estimates and corresponding 95% CIs.
SAS software (version 9.4; SAS Institute) SURVEYMEANS was used to account for sample weights and complex sample design.
Estimates based on <20 cases and total estimates of <1,200 emergency department visits are considered statistically unreliable and are not shown.
